description: Route 5, scope-(b): the ladder phase is NOT a constant-residue Kohno-Drinfeld holonomy angle. Elementary invariant, no transcendence needed — ln(q^2) = 2 ln q, so every c*ln satisfies f(q^2) = 2f(q), and alpha fails that identity in BOTH conventions as an explicit nonzero algebraic function. Separately: bean entry (7)'s 'EXACT: target / Re(log-gap) = -1/4' is a 0.32%% approximation for alpha_C (22.4%% for alpha_D, 8.52%% for the required phase) and provably cannot be exact, since exactness would make alpha = -(1/2) ln q. So BOTH discriminating parts of the branch-3 acceptance test are defective: part 1 is vacuous (a bar-symmetry test in disguise) and part 2 rests on a non-identity.
